fact: Deputy Minister of Science, Technology and Innovation Nomalungelo Gina launched assistive technologies funded through Technology Innovation Agency programmes, including the Ka-dah smartphone device for blind users, the WeSignIt sign-language app and the Virecom video interpreting service, at Central University of Technology in Bloemfontein on 4 August 2025.
